How Review Requests works in Noxtill, and where to check
How can a business automatically request customer reviews?

Choose a trigger (purchase, booking or completed service), a delay such as 1, 3 or 7 days, the channel (email or SMS) and the review platforms. Noxtill then sends each request automatically, covering Google review request automation and working as SMS review invitation software.
How does Review Requests software help a small business, and what should buyers evaluate?

More reviews build trust and help local rankings. When comparing automated review request software, a customer feedback request tool or review generation software for small business, check triggers, timing controls, channels, templates and supported review platforms.
